meta.crop: Tight story crop (Vali, 2026-11-11): all story sites except Safdarjung Hospital (off-frame, ~6.5 km south), plus ~250 m padding.

projection.formula: x = rad(lon - lon0) * R * cos(rad(lat0)); y = -rad(lat - lat0) * R   (metres; y points south for SVG)

meta.simplify: Douglas-Peucker: buildings 0.5 m, roads 0.7 m, green/water/rail 1 m; coords rounded to 0.1 m; buildings < 20 m² dropped
meta.encoding: Polygons and lines are flat [x0,y0,x1,y1,...] arrays. roads[]: {c: class, p: coords, n?: name, tunnel?, rb?: roundabout}. rail[]: {k: railway tag, p, tunnel?}.
